description:
Where is a shipping container now? Looks the container up with its carrier and
returns the latest journey: carrier, ports of loading and discharge, departure
and arrival dates (actual or estimated), transshipment ports, vessels per leg,
and each container's latest confirmed event. Dates are in the local time of
the port. Works for any container number, no account needed.

A first ask can take up to a minute while the carrier is checked. When the
answer has ``status: "checking"``, ask again in a minute with the same number.
``found: false`` means the carrier does not know the container.
name: track_container
title: Track a container
